name: 婴儿彩棉无骨缝连体爬服款
description: 贴身婴儿连体爬服：细腻织纹、平坦缝线、三色可选

styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshots and spec screens, warm oatmeal beige #F5F1E8 and milky off-white #FBFAF8 for info and scene shots
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft warm studio lighting, gentle front-left key, diffused shadows, cozy airy feel with soft contact shadows
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte neutral board #EFE9E1, cream rug and light wooden nursery surfaces
styleLock.typography: soft rounded sans-serif with generous letter spacing
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line baby-care icons only, single warm brown accent color
styleLock.presentationRules: stable product scale and placement across the set; garments folded or laid flat, edges smooth, never floating
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent soft warm baby-underwear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, warm oatmeal beige #F5F1E8, muted brown accent #B08968 and warm taupe text #6B5D52; soft warm studio lighting with a gentle front-left key, diffused shadows and a cozy airy feel; soft rounded sans-serif; consistent thin-line icon style; clean gentle product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale and placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表第一眼看清整件爬服轮廓，干净合规赢点击

Bright even high-key studio lighting, soft diffused, a soft contact shadow grounding the garment. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The garment occupies 60-70% of the frame, no extra whitespace around the layout. 8K commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no hangers, no model, no props, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no third-party character marks or trademark graphics, no cut-off edges.

provenance.notes: 10 屏逐一核对：屏1 婴儿模特(蓝背带裤)坐姿主视觉，标题为婴儿纯棉爬服、副标含彩棉与无印染字样；屏2 波浪罗纹面料特写与柔软/透气/吸汗图标条(柔软重复出现)；屏3 棕/绿/白三色叠放色卡、织布工艺说明与无骨缝制接缝特写；屏4 产品信息页(商品指数条、洗涤图标带温度数值、尺码表按身高段59-80)；屏5 尺码线稿图+绿色长袖爬服平铺(标注两用档)；屏6 白/棕两色平铺与开档款细节+模特展示入口；屏7-8 婴儿模特展示(可辨识面容，穿蓝色背带裤)；屏9 圆领、缝线微距配文案；屏10 按扣微距配无镍不锈钢字样。品类判定：源夹名为童装，但页面自述为婴幼儿内衣面料、品名为婴儿爬服，尺码表按身高段(59-80)月龄量级，成衣为贴身连体内衣形态，故改判 内衣家居服/儿童内衣。已剥离：婴儿模特面容(模板一律无真人面部或仅手部)、原品牌棉标与圆形logo、原标题文案与英文标语、全部尺码/洗涤/材质数值(改为 {callout_n} 或空白表格单元占位)、彩棉/无印染/无镍等工艺与材质断言、黄色气球道具与蓝色背带裤模特服。
